events.event: Search continued at an illegal gold mine in Nanggung (Pongkor), Bogor, where flooding trapped miners; police recovered 13 bodies and about 13 more were still believed trapped.
events.key_numbers: 13 bodies recovered · 6 identified by DVI · ~13 still trapped · 26 families reported missing relatives · flood on 23-24 Nov (CNBC headline cites 16 dead, unreconciled)
events.why_it_matters: Illegal gold mining keeps killing people while the financiers behind it are rarely touched.
events.spreading_evidence: detik terpopuler #1, #7; Antara video; CNBC and CNN headlines

events.event: Kupang Regent Yosef Lede admitted committing sexual violence after being named a suspect following a 15-hour examination, and said he will file a pretrial challenge (praperadilan).
events.key_numbers: 15-hour examination · suspect named 26 Nov · police say admission matches victim's visum results · victim is a 21-year-old student
events.why_it_matters: A sitting regional head is a suspect in a sexual-violence case, testing whether police act against officials.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia latest feed; multiple Jawa Pos network and viva pieces

events.event: Government opened the 2026 CPNS civil-servant selection registration on 27 November via SSCASN, with 154,052 positions; Presiden also prepared slots so PPPK teachers over 35 can join CPNS.
events.key_numbers: 154,052 formasi · registration opens 27 Nov 2026 · requirements simplified · PPPK teachers aged 35+ may apply
events.why_it_matters: Hundreds of thousands of job seekers will compete for stable state jobs starting today.
events.spreading_evidence: detik terpopuler #19; Antara infographic and Top News

events.event: Komdigi's Permen No. 7/2026 requires mobile operators Telkomsel, XL and Indosat to block scam-linked numbers within 24 hours of a request and requires biometric SIM registration.
events.key_numbers: block within 1x24 hours · 103,940 fraud reports 20 Oct 2024-19 Nov 2026 · 67,578 fraud content items handled · announced 24 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Everyone with a phone number is affected by biometric registration and faster scam-number blocking.
events.spreading_evidence: CNBC Indonesia latest feed; Antara infographics on digital scams

events.event: Antara and fact-checkers flagged a cluster of political hoaxes as most-read: Bahlil opening Ujung Kulon for mining, Jokowi arrested, Gibran summoned by TNI HQ, a Solo demo for Gibran's return, and a Purbaya/Jokowi PSI photo.
events.key_numbers: 5 Antara hoax debunks in Terpopuler · Ujung Kulon rhino-truck photo also rated SALAH (25 Nov) · Listyo Sigit prison photo rated SALAH (25 Nov)
events.why_it_matters: Fake political videos spread fastest during the VP succession drama, so people need to know how to spot them.
events.spreading_evidence: Antara Terpopuler: 5 of 8 items are hoax debunks

events.event: Prosecutors indicted former MPR Secretary General Ma'ruf Cahyono for receiving gratuities, including using them for his child's wedding.
events.why_it_matters: A top MPR official allegedly used gratuities for family events, as MPR runs the VP selection.

events.event: Kapolri Suyudi said Polri destroyed 601.7 tons of narcotics worth Rp61.68 trillion and that 247 foreigners became drug suspects in the past year.
events.key_numbers: 601.7 tons · Rp61.68 trillion · 56,000 cases · Rp1,425.6 trillion state money secured · 247 WNA suspects
events.why_it_matters: A record-sized drug destruction with a huge value tag; the Rp1,425.6 trillion figure needs context.
events.spreading_evidence: Antara photo and video; CNN Indonesia latest

events.event: Flooding in Pesisir Selatan, West Sumatra inundated 1,190 houses and cut access.
events.why_it_matters: Rainy-season floods are spreading across Sumatra, a year after the big Sumatra floods.

events.event: A 15-year-old junior-high student died in a student brawl (tawuran) in Tangerang, and a mosque caretaker (marbot) in Surabaya burned while sleeping died after treatment.
events.key_numbers: victim aged 15 · Surabaya suspect faces up to 12 years in prison
events.why_it_matters: Violent crime involving minors and religious workers draws wide public attention.

events.event: Police and ministers reported tightened immigration checks after 21 Indonesians nearly recruited as Russian mercenaries.
events.key_numbers: 21 WNI prevented · stricter immigration checks announced 24-25 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Young job seekers are lured abroad into war with high-salary promises.

events.event: Health test results of the two VP candidates Sugiono and Amran will be announced 1 December, ahead of the MPR plenary on 2 December.
events.key_numbers: announce 1 Dec · MPR plenary 2 Dec · 25 doctors involved · results handed by RSPAD to MPR on 26 Nov
events.why_it_matters: The next VP will be chosen within days; a name mismatch on Amran's SMA diploma is being rechecked.
